name: LegalEntityManagementRegister
tagline: Your whole group of companies – structure, filings, directors and lifecycle – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete entity management app for in-house legal and company secretaries: entity register, ownership structure with effective holdings, annual return / accounts / registered agent filings, compliance calendar, lifecycle board with business rules and a directors & officers view. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Ownership tree with direct and effective %
Circular ownership and missing parent detection
Annual return, accounts and agent renewal tracking with jurisdiction rules
Lifecycle rules: registration, agent and directors before Active; no open subsidiaries before dissolution
Board-seat guideline, resignations from one or all boards, appointments
Bulk counsel / agent / status, CSV export, undo
Demo mode with a fictional 34-entity group
